messages:
maya: Quick design sync — streaming UX tweaks I prototyped. Thoughts? ⬇️
sam: Nice! main changes?
maya: 1) Streaming bubble: show partial tokens but collapse to '…' when paused/regenerated. 2) Stop vs Pause: single primary button that toggles between Stop/Resume; Regen is secondary. 3) Token meter: compact icon + hover tooltip + aria-live announcement. 4) Prompt library quick-insert: keyboard shortcut (/) and inline preview.
lina: Can we keep explicit 'Stop' vs 'Pause'? product worried about accidental cancels.
devon: I prefer one control to reduce clutter. Maybe long-press for 'stop' vs 'pause'?
jorge: For screen reader: when streaming starts, aria-live polite should say 'Generating response, partial updates incoming' and when stopped say 'response generation paused' — a11y-bot flagged.
a11y-bot: Auto-check: ensure token counter updates are aria-hidden or announced only on focus to avoid noise.
maya: Good call. Proposal: token counter is aria-hidden by default; focusable with Alt+T opens compact panel that reads counts. Also keyboard nav: Space toggles flow, R triggers regenerate. Clipboard-friendly copy button.
sam: Emoji for status? green pulse when streaming, orange when paused, red when aborted. Also add small 'delta tokens' badge when regen uses fewer tokens.
lina: Copy tweaks: instead of 'Stop', use 'Pause stream'. Regen label: 'Regenerate full response' — longer but clearer.
devon: UX microcopy: token meter title -> 'Tokens used (est.)' and hover text: 'Estimate based on current prompt + streaming context'.
maya: Proto code snippet for keyboard map:

```json
{
  "Space": "toggle-stream",
  "R": "regenerate",
  "/": "open-prompt-library",
  "Alt+T": "open-token-panel"
}
```

any collisions with browser defaults?
jorge: Slash is used by browser search on some OS; maybe Cmd/Ctrl+K for prompt library instead.
sam: Also the auto-scroll: when streaming, if user scrolled up, stop auto-scroll. If at bottom, auto-scroll. Add tiny toast 'auto-scroll paused — jump to latest' with keyboard shortcut 'End'.
maya: A/B idea: compact mode (token meter inline) vs expanded (hover panel). Run on 5% for power users.
lina: :thumbsup: love the accessibility-first approach. Devon, can you mock the aria-live strings in Figma texts?
devon: Yep, will drop copy by EOD.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preview build for playground/ui-stream-keyboard at https://staging.redwood.ai/playground/preview — expires in 48h
maya: Thanks! I'll post the Figma link and short user test script in #product-research.
